description: Reads the app's user groups: "list" all groups, or with { group } its members and roles; "of" { user } the groups a user is in. Read-only; neblla_group changes them.

action.description: What to read. By action: of {user}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

group.description: list: the group whose members to list; left out: all groups.

name: neblla_group_read
title: Read user groups
